pairs: Behold, the Lord will lay waste to the earth,
and he will afflict its surface,
and he will scatter its inhabitants.
Et erit sicut populus, sic sacerdos;
And this shall be: as with the people,
sicut emens, sic ille qui vendit;
so with her mistress; as with the buyer,
as with the lender, so with the borrower;
The earth will be utterly devastated
Dominus enim locutus est verbum hoc.
For the Lord has spoken this word.
the loftiness of the people of the earth was weakened.
Et terra infecta est ab habitatoribus suis,
And the earth was corrupted by its inhabitants.
For they have transgressed the laws,
they have dissipated the everlasting covenant.
Because of this, a curse will devour the earth,
and its inhabitants will sin. And for this reason,
and few men will be left behind.
All those who were rejoicing in their hearts have groaned.
The gladness of the drums has ceased.
The sound of rejoicing has quieted.
The sweetness of stringed instruments has been silenced.
They will not drink wine with a song.
The drink will be bitter to those who drink it.
The city of vanity has been worn away.
Every house has been closed up;
Clamor erit super vino in plateis,
There will be a clamor for wine in the streets.
The gladness of the earth has been carried away.
Solitude is what remains in the city,
and calamity will overwhelm its gates.
Quia hæc erunt in medio terræ in medio populorum,
For so shall it be in the midst of the earth, in the midst of the people:
quomodo si paucæ olivæ quæ remanserunt excutiantur ex olea et racemi,
it is as if the few remaining olives are being shaken from the olive tree, and it is like a few clusters of grapes,
when the grape harvest has already ended.
These few shall lift up their voice
When the Lord will have been glorified,
they will make a joyful noise from the sea.
Propter hoc in doctrinis glorificate Dominum;
Because of this, glorify the Lord in doctrine: the name of the Lord,
in insulis maris nomen Domini Dei Israël.
the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea.
From the ends of the earth,
we have heard the praises of the glory of the Just One.
Those who would betray us have betrayed us,
and they have betrayed us with the betrayal of transgression.”
and the snare are over you,
qui fugerit a voce formidinis cadet in foveam;
whoever will flee from the voice of dread will fall into the pit.
et qui se explicaverit de fovea tenebitur laqueo;
And whoever will extricate himself from the pit will be caught in the snare.
quia cataractæ de excelsis apertæ sunt
For the floodgates from above have been opened,
and the foundations of the earth will be shaken.
The earth will be utterly broken!
The earth will be utterly crushed!
The earth will be utterly shaken!
The earth will stagger greatly, like a drunken man,
et auferetur quasi tabernaculum unius noctis;
and will be carried away, like the tent of a single night.
And its iniquity will be heavy upon it,
et corruet, et non adjiciet ut resurgat.
and it will fall and not rise up again.
in die illa visitabit Dominus super militiam cæli in excelso,
in that day, the Lord will visit upon the armies of the sky above,
et super reges terræ qui sunt super terram;
and upon the kings of the earth who are on the ground.
et congregabuntur in congregatione unius fascis in lacum,
And they will be gathered together like the gathering of one bundle into a pit.
And they will be enclosed in that place,
as in a prison. And after many days, they will be visited.
And the moon will be ashamed,
and the sun will be confounded,
cum regnaverit Dominus exercituum in monte Sion et in Jerusalem et in conspectu senum suorum fuerit glorificatus.
when the Lord of hosts will reign on mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and when he will have been glorified in the sight of his elders.
